name: Book
description: Store comprehensive book catalog information and availability status

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the book

fields.name: isbn
fields.description: International Standard Book Number for unique identification

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title of the book

fields.name: author
fields.description: Primary author or authors of the book

fields.name: category
fields.description: Genre or subject category for classification

fields.name: publicationYear
fields.description: Year the book was published

fields.name: totalCopies
fields.description: Total number of copies owned by the library

fields.name: availableCopies
fields.description: Number of copies currently available for checkout

constraints.availabilityCheck: availableCopies must be less than or equal to totalCopies

name: Member
description: Store library member profiles and membership status information

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the member

fields.name: membershipNumber
fields.description: Unique membership card number for library identification

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: Full name of the library member

fields.name: email
fields.description: Email address for communication and authentication

fields.name: phone
fields.description: Contact phone number

fields.name: membershipStatus
fields.description: Current status of membership (active, expired, suspended)

fields.name: membershipExpiryDate
fields.description: Date when the membership expires

fields.name: registrationDate
fields.description: Date when the member registered

name: LibrarySettings
description: Store system-wide configuration and operational parameters for library management

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for settings record

fields.name: defaultLoanPeriodDays
fields.description: Default number of days a book can be borrowed

fields.name: lateFeePerDay
fields.description: Late fee amount charged per day in currency units

fields.name: maxBooksPerMember
fields.description: Maximum number of books a member can borrow simultaneously

fields.name: reminderDaysBeforeDue
fields.description: Number of days before due date to send reminder notification

fields.name: enableNotifications
fields.description: Toggle to enable or disable email/SMS notifications

fields.name: lastUpdated
fields.description: Timestamp of last settings modification

constraints.singleton: Only one settings record should exist in the system
constraints.positiveValues: defaultLoanPeriodDays, lateFeePerDay, maxBooksPerMember, and reminderDaysBeforeDue must be positive numbers

name: NotificationLog
description: Track all automated notifications sent to members with delivery status and audit trail

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the notification log entry

fields.name: memberId
fields.description: Reference to the member who received the notification

fields.name: notificationType
fields.description: Type of notification (e.g., DUE_REMINDER, OVERDUE_NOTICE, RESERVATION_READY, ACCOUNT_UPDATE)

fields.name: deliveryChannel
fields.description: Channel used for delivery (EMAIL, SMS, PUSH, IN_APP)

fields.name: deliveryStatus
fields.description: Current status of notification (PENDING, SENT, DELIVERED, FAILED, BOUNCED)

fields.name: sentAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the notification was sent

fields.name: retryCount
fields.description: Number of delivery retry attempts made

fields.name: errorMessage
fields.description: Error details if delivery failed

relationships.description: Links notification to the recipient member

indexes.name: idx_member_id
indexes.description: Index for querying notifications by member

indexes.name: idx_sent_at
indexes.description: Index for chronological queries and reporting

indexes.name: idx_delivery_status
indexes.description: Index for filtering by delivery status for retry logic

constraints.notificationType: Must be one of: DUE_REMINDER, OVERDUE_NOTICE, RESERVATION_READY, ACCOUNT_UPDATE, RENEWAL_CONFIRMATION, FINE_NOTICE
constraints.deliveryChannel: Must be one of: EMAIL, SMS, PUSH, IN_APP
constraints.deliveryStatus: Must be one of: PENDING, SENT, DELIVERED, FAILED, BOUNCED
constraints.retryCount: Must be non-negative integer, maximum 3 retries

name: Checkout
description: Track active and historical book borrowing transactions with checkout dates, due dates, and return information

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the checkout transaction

fields.name: bookId
fields.description: Reference to the borrowed book

fields.name: memberId
fields.description: Reference to the member borrowing the book

fields.name: checkoutDate
fields.description: Date and time when the book was checked out

fields.name: dueDate
fields.description: Date when the book is due to be returned

fields.name: returnDate
fields.description: Actual date when the book was returned (null if still checked out)

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the checkout (active, returned, overdue)

relationships.description: Each checkout is associated with one book
Each checkout is associated with one member

indexes.description: Index for querying checkouts by book
Index for querying member borrowing history

businessRules: returnDate must be null or greater than checkoutDate
dueDate must be greater than checkoutDate
status should be 'returned' when returnDate is set

name: OverdueRecord
description: Track overdue books and associated late fee calculations

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the overdue record

fields.name: checkoutId
fields.description: Reference to the overdue checkout

fields.name: daysOverdue
fields.description: Number of days the item is overdue

fields.name: lateFeeAmount
fields.description: Calculated late fee amount in currency

fields.name: paymentStatus
fields.description: Payment status: pending, paid, waived

fields.name: lastNotificationDate
fields.description: Date of the last overdue notification sent

fields.name: resolvedDate
fields.description: Date when the overdue was resolved (returned or paid)

relationships.description: Links to the checkout that became overdue

constraints.daysOverdue: Must be greater than or equal to 0
constraints.lateFeeAmount: Must be greater than or equal to 0
